7894674.note: After desilting in 2023-24, this canal-fed waterbody held water +3.2 weeks a year compared with 10 similar untreated waterbodies within 20 km, over 2023-24 and 2024-25. That is within the range untreated waterbodies show by chance, so no change can be told apart. A change smaller than one season may not show in seasonal data. 902 m³ of silt was removed, about 0.04 m over its area. Caution: water follows river flows or canal releases. Across 3 desilted canal-fed waterbodys in Sangli district, the average change is +1.7 weeks a year.
